current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，采用领导-工作者模式，领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分，工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回训练结果，领导节点汇总结果计算梯度并同步更新所有计算节点上的模型，从而显著加速GNN训练，在链路预测任务上的F1分数显著高于其他分布式图神经网络模型。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, which adopts a leader-worker mode. The leader node partitions the original graph using an edge segmentation based graph flow partition algorithm, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology, and return training results through an attention layer. The leader summarizes results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes, significantly accelerating GNN training with F1 score on link prediction significantly higher than other distributed GNN models.
technical_features: 采用领导-工作者模式，领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点，领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: Adopts leader-worker mode, leader node partitions original graph using an edge segmentation based graph flow partition algorithm
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to leader through an attention layer; leader summarizes results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes
